rule: R2 passes when the judged share is no lower than the control share minus quality.jury.maxShareGap (0.2)
note: It passes by the rule: 0 of 10 on the judged pictures against 0 of 5 on the control, and the judged share is no lower than the control share less 0.2. What the rule does not see: no juror took any picture of the build for a photograph or a film frame; 9 of 10 chose (d) and one chose (c). The approved image drew two (d) and three (c), so the approved picture is more often taken for an ordinary render and the build's for a web demo, and almost every juror of both gave the same reason: the picture is laid out as a web page with a pointer on it. All 15 jurors answered and none was replaced.
